Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Distribution Companies | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: DES-002-r0a | Equipment:
 Medium Voltage Distributors
Issued to: 
 Distribution Companies
Status: 
 Approved
Approval date: 
 08 February 2005 | Procedure:
 Major Maintenance Every Two Years 
 (P2-Y2)
Next review date: 
 February 2010
Introduction
This document sets out the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be carried out every two years on medium voltage distributors, as indicated above by the code Y2, and the document was prepared, reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators of all electricity distribution companies.
This maintenance is carried out to raise the efficiency of the distribution panel equipment and is executed according to the manufacturer's instructions, with replacement and renewal of the distributor components that need to be changed, in order to avoid sudden faults.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card. | 
Fence off the work location and post warning signs. | 
Wear occupational safety and health equipment. | 
Ensure the availability of sound tools, instruments and equipment and the spare parts used in maintenance. | 
Ensure absence of voltage from the supply source using the voltage indicator on the part to be worked on. | 
Ensure the cable disconnect switches are opened and isolated from all their sources. | 
Ensure portable earthing is applied to the equipment to be worked on. | 
Ensure the DC supply of the protection devices is disconnected. | 
Ensure the cells are numbered and named from the front and back. | 
Ensure the occupational safety and health and protection officials are present at the site. | 
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Emergency lighting machine. | 
Complete tool bag (set of sockets, set of screwdrivers, set of Allen keys, set of open-end spanners, etc.). | 
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, goggles, cotton overalls with sleeves, etc. | 
Blower, portable earth, cleaning brushes and soft clean cloth pieces. | 
Suitable electrical grease, lubricating oil, paint material, paint primer. | 
Earth resistance measuring device, avometer, tested voltage indicator, hydrometer. | 
Torque wrench, spare lighting lamps, starters, transformers. | 
Fire extinguisher and sensor hose, insulating hoses for the phases. | 
Numbering machine, first aid bag. |
